annotation.evidence_span: MUST be sent in their entirety
annotation.interpretation_a: The entire payload body must be buffered in memory by the client before any HTTP/2 frames are sent.
annotation.interpretation_b: The client can stream the payload body as it becomes available, but must not send any HTTP/2 frames until the last byte of the payload body has been sent.
annotation.justification: The phrase "in their entirety" is open to interpretation. Does it mean the client must buffer the entire payload before sending *any* HTTP/2 frames, or simply that the payload transmission must be complete before sending frames? Both are reasonable interpretations.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether the 'entirety' refers to buffering the entire payload or simply completing transmission of the payload.
